evidence.claim: profileId/hardwareRevision TGC_LAB_ESP32_4M is a LAB design-target designation, not a vendor PCB revision
evidence.source: This package is created from a BUILD TARGET decision (owner instruction 2026-09-04), not from physical board verification. No board is proven for this profile; the designation names the target facts (classic ESP32, 4MB, DIO).

Board definition 'ESP32 Dev Module' (fqbn esp32:esp32:esp32) of the installed arduino-cli core esp32:esp32 3.3.10; compile options FlashSize=4M, FlashMode=dio, PartitionScheme=custom verified present in the board menu

Selected explicitly from the available 'ESP32 Dev Module' board definition menu (FlashSize=4M default, FlashMode=dio conservative universal choice for classic ESP32 modules). This is the design target; the real flash of any future physical board must still be verified by read-only detection before flashing
ESP32 classic chip capability (Wi-Fi/BLE radio) per Espressif ESP32 datasheet and the esp32:esp32 core's Wi-Fi stack used by the sketch

evidence.claim: partitionScheme tgc-ota-4mb (nvs 0x9000/0x5000, otadata 0xe000/0x2000, ota_0 0x10000/0x1E0000, ota_1 0x1F0000/0x1E0000, coredump 0x3D0000/0x10000)
evidence.source: TGC repo products/tgc/tgc_initial_lab_esp32/partitions.csv — layout designed in this repo for the 4MB target: two 0x1E0000 (1,966,080 B) OTA slots, offsets contiguous (0x10000+0x1E0000=0x1F0000, 0x1F0000+0x1E0000=0x3D0000, 0x3D0000+0x10000=0x3E0000 <= 0x400000). NOT copied from the TMM tmm-ota-4mb table (different slot sizes and offsets) and NOT from the TGC ESP32-S3 tgc-ota-16mb table.
